mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 63 degrees and partly cloudy at Verona City Hall under a waxing gibbous moon, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, visibility will be blocked by the clouds.

City officials have announced that road maintenance, specifically crack filling, will begin on September 28 across several areas including Nine Mound Road, Commerce Parkway, and various streets near Jefferson and Franklin. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development projects on October 5, including sites at Country View Court and the Liberty Business Park.

It is a busy week in Verona! Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, Wednesday features live music and trivia at various venues, while the Verona Fall Fest is scheduled for September 25 at Hometown USA Festival Park.
Looking at the latest report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was detained after a window was broken and a firearm was recovered.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed today for a remodel, so we look forward to their return to serving up fresh flavors soon.
